english.title: Member of crew of UK aircraft fail to wear survival suit as required
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a member of the crew of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), failed to wear a survival suit when such a suit was required to be carried by article 119 of, and Part 1 of Schedule 6 to, the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 118(2) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
